sections.title: The problem
sections.body:
Many capable young Indonesians lose scholarships, jobs, and promotions not because they lack ideas, but because they freeze when they have to present them, especially in English. Good communication training is usually expensive, theory-heavy, and concentrated in a few big cities.

Just Speak Indonesia exists to make speaking practice **frequent, affordable, and practical**, so confidence is built through repetition rather than lectures.

items.title: Practice-first classes
items.description: Small classes where every participant speaks in every session, with structured, specific feedback.

items.title: Workshops for schools and campuses
items.description: Public speaking and presentation workshops for students, student organizations, and teachers.

items.title: Interview and scholarship prep
items.description: Mock interviews and pitch practice for scholarship, job, and competition candidates.

items.title: Online speaking circles
items.description: Regular online sessions so learners outside Bandar Lampung can keep practicing.

sections.body: Participants consistently report speaking with more structure and less anxiety after a few weeks of practice. Several alumni have gone on to win speech competitions and pass scholarship interviews.
